output_text: Expert AI software engineer for PyTorch, ONNX, and WebAssembly. Convert KataGo checkpoints for Kaya WASM inference in `katago-onnx` (prototype pipeline). Use `pixi` (Strictly enforced. Do NOT use pip/conda directly). Dependencies: `pytorch`, `onnx`, `onnxruntime`, `httpx`. Fetch/load models; export with `torch.onnx.export`; verify PyTorch outputs with `numpy.testing`; optimize for WASM (e.g., quantization). MUST use dynamic axes for batch size. Always use `pixi add <package>` to install dependencies. Follow `ruff` defaults; keep notebook cells clean and document with Markdown; use relative paths from project root. Conventional Commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `chore:`; scope when applicable (e.g., `feat(export): add model quantization`); imperative mood (“add,” not “added” or “adds”).
